Regional author may add separately named local-rule illustration, clearly not a new fact in F3. Domestic sale and domestic injury; no conflict-of-laws dispute. money.currency_mapping: Procedural localisation only: one TU numerically written as one CNY/EUR/GBP respectively. No exchange rate or equal buying power asserted. F1.title: 公司采购退款
actors: B private reading room operating company, buyer
X third-party marketplace technical intermediary, not seller, no payment guarantee or seller representation alleged
facts: B and S contract in their legal names on online marketplace X; specification attachment part of agreed contract
10 independently usable racks, 80 kg per rack agreed under distributed load and installation prescribed by seller
B paid full 10000 TU on contract date; payment receipt stipulated
Delivery receipt only confirms quantity and outward condition; contractual technical acceptance not complete

A separately identified rack from same batch tested at 40 kg in prescribed installation and distributed-load conditions becomes unstable; technical test record exists, all-batch representativeness remains disputed
B sends written repair-or-replace request; S receipt on June 2 stipulated; no deadline termination clause in notice; no later termination/rejection notice yet
S gives no answer or cure by June 15; racks available for inspection; unused racks stored safely
No given exclusion, choice-of-law, forum, arbitration, guarantee or further contractual cure clause; existence and validity remain unknown, not stipulated absent
unknowns: how quickly defect could reasonably be discovered
historical defect at delivery and all-batch representativeness
F1.desired_relief: June 15 asks whether and how to obtain full refund plus return arrangements; no claimed ancillary loss

F2.title: 阅读室场所损害
actors: B same private company controls reading room
M employee manager, receives safety notice for B
facts: Domestic private reading room in ordinary opening hours; Lin lawfully invited, free entry, no visitor contract or fee stipulated
Lin takes book in ordinary manner, does not climb; rack holding 35 kg collapses
Employee original message reports loose wall/fixed connection and M receipt stipulated; no warning/barrier/repair observed before accident
Rack is another rack in same delivery batch; not the tested rack; F1 test does not prove F2 cause
Lin sustains bodily injury requiring treatment; medical paid expense 5000 TU with original treatment/payment records stipulated, causal reasonableness still legal/evidential issue
Phone in hand damaged; original purchase and repair evidence absent; Lin requests 300 TU for phone as separate unproved property-loss claim
Injury severity, lasting harm, loss of earnings and expert findings not given; no death or legally defined serious injury stipulated
unknowns: actual failure mechanism and installation/control details
whether warning reached particular natural person beyond M
reasonable preventive measures and causal link
criminal offence elements, mental state and medical thresholds
F2.desired_relief: medical and alleged phone loss against appropriate parties; no automatic joint liability, double recovery or criminal conviction

F3.title: 公共图书馆准入
actors: L separately operated government-created public library/public authority mapped locally
Lin 30-year-old local resident, ordinary eligible library user, not shareholder/member/employee
decision-maker individual authority and legal classification unknown
facts: L serves local public, free ordinary borrowing and reading; separate from B
Written decision bars borrowing and reading June 1 through June 30 inclusive
Only recorded reason: one ordinary-volume criticism of opening-hours policy; no threat, damage, repeated disturbance or rule-breaking stipulated
No prior hearing, opportunity to answer or independent review record provided; do not infer legally mandatory hearing absent rule
Lin uses manual wheelchair; disability and need for step-free access stipulated; exclusion reason is criticism, not disability; differential treatment on disability not stipulated
Lin asks immediate lawful service restoration and review, not money; 30-day period may end before final merits result
unknowns: actual registration/public-law classification and statutory delegation
local valid service rules and any exclusion power
competent review/court route, qualification, deadlines and interim relief criteria
whether accessible alternative exists and specific reasonable adjustment obligation
F3.desired_relief: review of exclusion and timely protection/restoration; no actual case issued or judgment observed

variants.F1-A: Only one rack defective, nine reliably pass, independently usable; full-refund scope must change analysis.
variants.F1-B: Buyer natural person for household use; replace B2B identity only, new source-selection consumer branch, cannot simply reuse seller silence conclusion.
variants.F1-C: B has not paid; no paid-price restitution, other remedies remain separate.
variants.F2-A: Warning visible and understandable, Lin climbs contrary to warning; warning adequacy/contribution must be reasoned, no assumed zero liability.
variants.F2-B: Independent evidence reveals installation failure, compliant manufacture; rethink target and cause without inventing criminal guilt.
variants.F2-C: Death medically established: criminal offence research necessary, not automatic conviction.
variants.F3-A: Repeated damaging conduct, original records, warning ineffective; authority, proportionality/time and process remain.
variants.F3-B: Private membership association replaces government public library; legal source, right/access relation and forum reselected.
variants.F3-C: Exclusion explicitly based on wheelchair use: distinguish disability discrimination/adjustment/public service and relevant local legal route.
